## Appearance

Morgan is a short and stout woman. She has gray hair and wears a tweed suit.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_

## Personality

Morgan is a kindhearted and engaging individual whose warmth easily earns the affection of others. Having traveled extensively, she is both a skilled storyteller and a delightful conversationalist whose brilliant nature naturally commands admiration.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P42](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0042)_

## History

Morgan is a famous author who has traveled extensively and written numerous books about girls. She was initially scheduled to visit [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), but her trip was delayed after she sprained her ankle. When she later arrived with [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md), she was entertained by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and treated to a lovely dinner and a walk through the surrounding woods.

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P2](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0002), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P3](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0003), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P6](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0006), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P9](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0009), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P11](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0011), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P13](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0013), +54 more_

## Relationships

### [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/morgan--pendexter.md)

Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) is a companion of Mrs. Morgan, traveling alongside her to visit [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). She joins Morgan for a dinner hosted by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and a subsequent stroll through the nearby woods.

- Friend of — friend visiting together  <sub>[v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P24](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0024)</sub>

### [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/morgan--priscilla-grant.md)

[Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) is Mrs. Morgan's niece and social acquaintance. [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) attempts to facilitate a visit between her aunt and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), though an initial meeting is canceled when Morgan sprains her ankle. [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) later successfully accompanies her famous aunt and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for a walk and dinner with [Anne](../character/anne.md).

- Friend of — acquaintances visiting together  <sub>[v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P14](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0014)</sub>
- Relative of — niece of Mrs. Charlotte E.
